description: Structural subset of the AER validator (docs/architecture C.17: AER-V04..V07, V12 closed party list, V16 closed reasons, V18 $-forms and ext.lex shape, structural parts of V26 and V30..V33). One JSON object per line of an .aer.jsonl file. The in-code validator is authoritative; this schema is published for consumers and differentially tested against it. aer/0.2: a part's text, args or value may be absent when the record's unk declares it withheld or not_captured (D-211), and a degenerate file's header (header, run scope and seal only) may omit task.task_id when its unk declares it not_captured (D-219). This schema holds the header's unk condition; the part conditions and the degenerate file shape are held by the in-code validator. A $utf16 payload is base64 of an even byte count, and $lit wraps an object with a member name beginning with $ (pre-round review #28); that the $utf16 units are not a valid scalar sequence is held in code.
title: AgentPROV Execution Record (aer/0.2): one record
